_comment: DE4SDV driver-assistance bench (INC-DRIVING-002): the ids of the S-CORE path and the guests.
Draft, not yet validated. Section icd is the machine-readable copy of the ids that ICD.md proposes;
interfaces/tests/test_service_ids.py keeps it equal to ICD.md's tables. Section lane_choices holds
the values the warning path's configs need that ICD.md does not fix; each is a proposal of the
warning-contract lane, open for the lead, except where its source names the model.
The model is the authority: the signal mappings MAP-DRIVING-DA-COMMAND, MAP-DRIVING-DA-WARNING-REQUEST
None of these ids is model content until the phase 10b pull request types it.

icd.status: ICD.md proposal: fixed for the implementation, not model content

lane_choices.status: warning-contract lane proposal, not in ICD.md: open for the lead unless the source says model

mw_com_warning_request.source: the INC-DRIVING-001 kit's 7406 entry (slots 20, one subscriber, PreSerializedData<2048>); the candidate's own manifest must say the same

gateway.source: the INC-DRIVING-001 kit's gateway config, with new names and application ids

someipd_vsomeip.source: unicast: the model (the S-CORE host takes 192.168.98.1 on the VXLAN segment); the rest: the INC-DRIVING-001 kit, with a new network name

sdv_core_broker.source: the platform's SOME/IP broker, as the INC-DRIVING-001 interop names it; the catalog directory is new

ivi_subscriber.source: lane proposal for the IVI app (B10), which must claim the same subject
